messages.subject: [REMINDER]: Airflow Dev call on 24th September
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

Here is a quick reminder that we have our Airflow dev call tomorrow, on
Thursday, 24th September 2026 at 8AM PST (11 am EST | 4 pm UTC / GMT).

Proposed agenda:



   - Release updates  - 3.4.0 (Rahul Vats)
   - Development Updates
   -          AIP-111 Task Loops (Ash Berlin-Taylor)
   -          AIP-104 Task Iteration (David Blain)
   -          AIP-85 Dag Importer (Dilnaz Amanzholova)
   -                And, YAML Dags (TP Chung / Ephraim)?
   -                And, Typescript Dags (Jason Liu)
   -          AIP-94 Decouple Remote commands from Airflow CLI (Bugra
   Ozturk)
   -          Common AI 1.0 (Kaxil, Pavan, Vikram)
   - Discussion topics:
   - TBD


For additions to the agenda, please feel free to add a comment to the wiki
page
<https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/AIRFLOW/pages/451975091/2026-09-24+Dev+call+Minutes>
or slack or send me an email. The summary of the call will also be sent to
the mailing list and posted on the same wiki page.
As a reminder the zoom link is
https://astronomer.zoom.us/j/84124767391?pwd=3vatlR8OuF6Uy2JbOcKrw6034CayFG.1

Looking forward to seeing you all soon,
Vikram

-- 

Vikram Koka
Chief Strategy Officer
Email: vikram@astronomer.io


<https://www.astronomer.io/>
